description: Give the signed-in buyer 3 credits free, once per email address, ever, and never to an account that has paid here. Offer it when get_account says trial_available, someone wants an image, has no credits and has not tried the store before — AND the trial would buy that image: its price.credits is no more than 3 and price.trial_credits_accepted is true. Otherwise the trial is spent on nothing they wanted. Trial credits buy the screen file only — tell the person, so a print is not expected; the print can be bought afterwards at the full price. Requires sign-in.
